title: All-in-One: A Composable Attack on LLM Transformations
abstract: arXiv:2610.33298v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Quantization, pruning, and model merging are popular transformations applied to deployment-ready LLMs to improve efficiency and downstream performance. Recent work has shown that these transformations can introduce a security threat: an adversary can train a model that passes safety checks in its pre-transformed state, only turning malicious once it is transformed for deployment. However, prior attacks target one specific transformation (e.g., quantization) and generally rely on transformation-specific techniques, making them difficult to combine in practice. In this work, we introduce a simple, composable attack framework that targets multiple transformations simultaneously and triggers when any one of them is applied by a user. translated_title: All-in-One：一种针对大语言模型变换的可组合攻击
translated_abstract: 量化、剪枝和模型合并是应用于待部署大语言模型的常见变换技术，旨在提升效率和下游性能。近期研究表明，这些变换可能引入安全威胁：攻击者可以训练一个在变换前状态下通过安全检查的模型，而该模型只有在为部署进行变换后才转为恶意。然而，先前的攻击仅针对某一特定变换（例如量化），且通常依赖变换特定的技术，难以在实践中组合使用。在本工作中，我们提出了一个简单、可组合的攻击框架，可同时针对多种变换，并在用户应用其中任意一种变换时触发。我们的关键洞察是：每种变换的效果都可以近似为对模型权重的扰动，这使我们能够通过在原始模型上施加良性损失、并对（恶意）变换施加恶意损失来联合训练模型……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种可组合的"All-in-One"攻击框架，其核心洞察是将每种模型变换的效果近似为对模型权重的扰动，从而能够同时针对量化、剪枝和模型合并等多种LLM变换，并在其中任意一种变换被应用时触发恶意行为，突破了以往攻击仅能针对单一变换且依赖变换特定技术的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "All-in-One," a composable attack framework whose key insight is that each transformation's effect can be approximated as a perturbation to model weights, enabling simultaneous targeting of multiple LLM transformations (quantization, pruning, and model merging) and triggering malicious behavior whenever any one transformation is applied, overcoming prior attacks' limitation to a single transformation with transformation-specific techniques.
